nodes.evidence: NetworkChaos delay 2000ms / 100% loss to email service, mode one, AllInjected confirmed
checkout sends notification synchronously over the order path
delay: OK at 4882/5307/4965ms; loss: DEADLINE_EXCEEDED at 10011/10009/10004ms

hypothesis: non-critical email notification is not isolated from the primary order path; a slow or unavailable email service should not delay or hang PlaceOrder

delay_case.note: 2s email delay adds ~3s to end-to-end PlaceOrder; email serially blocks the order path

loss_case.note: 100% email loss hangs PlaceOrder to the 10s client deadline; no isolation, no fallback

cross_project.note: mirrors Online Boutique email finding (KB-OB-CHECKOUT-EMAIL-FAILURE-001): non-critical side-effect coupling is a replicated pattern

exclusions: single PlaceOrder path; email delay/loss only, no send timeout differentiation

next_evidence: verify whether email send uses an explicit short timeout in checkout source
test with a 1s email delay to find the coupling threshold
